
❯ look at the stale export

● What does a reader actually get when the export runs twice? Two archives with the same name, the second silently
  replacing the first, which is fine for them and was never the bug.

  The bug was the manifest: it was written before the images finished uploading, so a reader who downloaded during
  that window got a manifest listing files that were not there yet. The manifest is now written last, after every
  upload has resolved, and a test pins the order by making one upload slow.

  Committed as one change with its test, pushed to dev. Scoped tests, typecheck and the full suite are all green.
